meta.name: Kajal
meta.tagline: Creative coder — music, code, generative art

entries.title: Software Engineer
entries.summary: Shipped audio-first features across web and mobile.
entries.detail: Led the **audio platform** team. Owned the WebAudio engine and shipped a real-time collaborative DAW used by 40k+ creators. Cut Time-to-Interactive by 38%.

entries.title: Generative Garden
entries.summary: A Canvas 2D generative-art series that blooms to audio.
entries.detail: An ongoing series of **audio-reactive generative pieces** rendered entirely with Canvas 2D. Each sketch maps FFT bins to botanical growth rules — no two blooms alike.

entries.title: Music as Code
entries.summary: A talk on live-coding music in the browser.
entries.detail: A 30-minute talk demonstrating how to compose generative music with **Strudel**, from a blank repl to a finished piece — and why constraints (scales, quantization) make you more creative.

entries.title: M.Sc. Computer Science
entries.detail: Thesis on **real-time spectral processing** for browser-based music tools. Graduate TA for the intro graphics course.
